The '''Xanlanner system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wyl sector/Legends|Wyl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

The system was located near the [[Uziel system]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|341}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The system is misspelled Xanlannes in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
